name: appmixer.shopify.customers.CreateCustomer
description: Create a customer, optionally with an address, email marketing consent, tax exemptions and metafields.
author: Jimoh Damilola <jimoh@client.io>

email.label: Email
email.tooltip: The customer's email address. Must be unique in the store.

phone.label: Phone
phone.tooltip: The customer's phone number in E.164 format, for example +16135551111. Must be unique in the store.

acceptsEmailMarketing.label: Subscribe to Email Marketing
acceptsEmailMarketing.tooltip: Record that the customer agreed to receive marketing emails (single opt-in). Needs an email address.

addressFirstName.label: First Name
addressFirstName.tooltip: First name on the address. Defaults to the customer's first name.

addressLastName.label: Last Name
addressLastName.tooltip: Last name on the address. Defaults to the customer's last name.

provinceCode.label: Province Code
provinceCode.tooltip: Province or state code, for example ON or CA. Required for countries with provinces (US, Canada, …).

countryCode.label: Country Code
countryCode.tooltip: Two-letter ISO country code, for example US or CZ. The address is added only when at least one address field is filled in.

taxExempt.label: Tax Exempt
taxExempt.tooltip: Whether the customer is exempt from paying taxes on their orders.

taxExemptions.label: Tax Exemptions
taxExemptions.tooltip: Specific tax exemptions (Canada, US resellers, EU reverse charge).

metafields.label: Metafields
metafields.tooltip: Custom data stored on the customer. A metafield with the same namespace and key is overwritten.

namespace.label: Namespace
namespace.tooltip: Groups metafields, for example "custom". Defaults to the app's namespace when empty.

key.label: Key
key.tooltip: Name of the metafield within the namespace, for example "loyalty_level".

type.label: Type
type.tooltip: Type of the value. Must match the metafield definition, if the store has one for this namespace and key.

value.label: Value
value.tooltip: The value, as text (numbers, true/false, dates in ISO 8601, JSON as a string).

optInLevel.title: Default Phone Number.SMS Marketing Consent.Opt-in Level

updatedAt.title: Default Phone Number.SMS Marketing Consent.Updated At
